limitations: P1 is a bundled prompt intervention, not isolation of one word or camera term.
Prompt changes requested framing/action, so whole-frame GT DINO is auxiliary rather than a prompt-compliance score.
Existing five cases do not validate general background, state, event or multi-evidence use.
No claim that free-form text can assign semantic roles to appended reference tokens without training.
P2 and P3 preserve the complete P1 shot/action text and add sentences; wording, length and repetition effects are not isolated.
P2/P3 earlier-view wording is applied unchanged to Local-only controls even when no remote reference is supplied.
P3 is a positive-text hypothesis; it does not implement attention masks, semantic routing or a negative-prompt branch.

requested_prompt_scope.this_update: Prompt drafting and experiment-plan update only; no generation or text encoding performed.
